text.text: Sega's first 3D arcade board, home to Virtua Racing and Virtua Fighter, which opened the era of polygon arcade games.

text.text: Primeira placa de arcade 3D da Sega, com Virtua Racing e Virtua Fighter, que abriu a era dos jogos de arcade em polígonos.
